planets.name: TOI-1736 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1736 with a 7.07-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-1736 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1736. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
